lines: css holds 3 stylesheets, 1,543 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.
Imported by a source file, so they reach the browser through the bundle and not as this file: collections.css (src/init-collections.js).
Named nowhere in lib/, templates/ or src/: activity.css 635 B.
Unless something outside lib/, templates/ or src/ loads the ones named nowhere, no page receives them. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
moment, 594,253 B on the deck-dashboard page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
lodash, 73,416 B on the deck-main page: the full build; lodash-es with named imports ships only what is used.
38 files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (171 packages, 1,194 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
